title: A Mountain Adventure
text:
Last summer, Maria went on a trip to the mountains with her brother. They wanted an adventure, so they chose a hiking trail that was ten kilometers long. The first day was sunny, and they walked slowly to enjoy the view. In the evening, they set up a small tent next to a river.

On the second day, the weather changed. It started to rain, and the path became very wet and slippery. Maria was a little scared, but her brother helped her cross a narrow bridge. At the end of the trip, they were tired but very happy.

questions.text: Where did Maria go last summer?
What happened to the weather on the second day?
Why did Maria's brother help her cross the bridge?
options: He wanted to take a photo
The bridge was narrow and she was scared
He was trying to go home early

questions.text: What can we infer about the trip overall?
options: It was a bad experience they want to forget
It was a tiring but enjoyable adventure
They stopped hiking on the first day
They got lost in the forest

vocabulary.definition: a path through the countryside, often used for walking
difficult to walk on or hold because it is wet or smooth

paragraph_translations: Geçen yaz Maria, kardeşiyle birlikte dağlara bir gezintiye çıktı. Macera istediklerinden on kilometre uzunluğunda bir yürüyüş patikasını seçtiler. İlk gün güneşliydi ve manzaranın tadını çıkarmak için yavaş yavaş yürüdüler. Akşam olunca nehrin yanında küçük bir çadır kurdular.

İkinci gün hava değişti. Yağmur yağmaya başladı ve patika çok ıslak ve kaygan oldu. Maria biraz korkmuştu, ama kardeşi dar bir köprüyü geçmesine yardım etti. Gezinin sonunda yorgundular ama çok mutluydular.
